The Port of Doraleh, west of Djibouti City, is a complex of container, oil and bulk terminals opened from 2009 onward, which handles most of the trade of landlocked Ethiopia.

After Ethiopia lost its coast with Eritrea's independence, and especially after the war of 1998, almost all its trade moved to Djibouti. The container terminal was built and run by Dubai's DP World, and a multipurpose port built by Chinese firms opened in 2017, tied to the new electric railway.

In 2018 the government seized the DP World terminal, starting a long legal fight. The ports, with the bases, are the main business of Djibouti.
sum: The Port of Doraleh, west of Djibouti City, is a complex of container, oil and bulk terminals opened from 2009 onward, which handles most of the trade of landlocked Ethiopia.
